notes.title: Thank You
notes.notes:
For everyone who played whether you like it or not thank you. If you hated it, sorry, I tried and will learn from my mistakes on this one. For those who like it, I'm so happy. I did this as more of a project for me cause I want to get into making games and wanted to see something through to release, but I know I can and will do better. 

Thank you again.

PS.
(not an excuse but just a FYI)
solo dev with a full time job and a new born.
Also working on more games and making this one better.
